scope: First development evaluation of fall, routed recovery, standing and forward walking in one uninterrupted shared-plant episode.
resource_rule: Prefer the previously qualified 3072 worlds after bounding the complete 32-second trace. Only choose a lower scale before dynamics if the measured resource guard requires it.

controller.first_request: Translate observed joint positions into the incoming policy HOME, start that policy with its own empty raw history, project the new request and bridge from the last physical target.
controller.physics: Retain the accepted full-contact getup plant, timing and noise throughout. Keep per-model raw histories separate from the applied actuator target.

acceptance: Retain the original timely and final four-pose getup score before switching.
Use controller-observable readiness. Keep every failed or unswitched world in the denominator.
Require stable standing during the declared one-second phase, followed by the original 20-second forward gates.
Verify the first boundary and applied target slew for both switches, source states, sensor and action clocks, and uninterrupted recording.
Qualify independently before proceeding to seven-command switching and bounded model randomization.
